channel.title: Tampa Bay News Monitor

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Appeals court halts Trump's ballroom project, says Congress must approve it
item.description: An appeals court has ruled that President Donald Trump must seek approval from Congress to build his proposed White House ballroom, saying construction must stop.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Best family-friendly getaways for fall 2026
item.description: With back-to-school season underway, many families assume vacation plans are over. But according to travel expert Tomeka Jones, fall may actually be one of the best times to plan a family getaway.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Drought forces water rationing across Puerto Rico amid shortage
item.description: Puerto Rico will begin water rationing in San Juan and nearby cities as severe drought and extreme heat worsen across the island.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Paul Renner and his vow to stay in Florida's gubernatorial race despite polling challenges
item.description: Paul Renner is escalating his attacks, warning Byron Donalds is unprepared and could cost Republicans the general election against Democrat David Jolly.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Cases of a fungus found in healthcare facilities, are rising rapidly
item.description: Cases of Candida auris, a fungus found in healthcare facilities, are rising rapidly this year, the US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention says.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] AI creates 16 new viruses from scratch, showing promise and drawing warnings
item.description: Scientists used an artificial intelligence program to create new viral genomes that are different from any known natural viruses and that targeted specific hosts, according to a new study.
